name: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B

lineage.how_derived: LoRA adapter trained to penalize reasoning-marker tokens that trigger overthinking, plus a transfer component from ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B; sibling of swift-1.5-qwen3.8-flash-next in this database

purpose: Reasoning-efficient Qwen3.8-27B: 58.3 percent fewer thinking tokens with under 1 percent loss, about 1.95x faster on several tasks (card).

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout)
